text: FMD: regular vaccination with a trivalent (O+A+Asia1) vaccine; typically alum-based and given once a year, with emergency re-vaccination if an outbreak occurs in neighboring communes/districts. Hemorrhagic Septicemia: alum vaccine given at 6-month intervals, ideally timed before the rainy season; calves get good protection from maternal antibodies if the dam is vaccinated during the last months of pregnancy.
